description:
compiler2_pull_telemetry_is_bounded_and_keeps_public_trace_signals is RED on wt/kdt-causality (green on main). Measured on 00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref (interp, debug): events 946 -> 1242, bytes 294,064 -> 878,599 (budget 1000 / 320KB). On 00009_no_runtime: events 145 -> 189 (budget 300, still green), bytes 44,870 -> 100,495 (budget 96KB, ALSO red -- masked because the event assert on 00181 fires first).

Event delta is exactly the kdt.34 arc's deliberate public-stream growth: +252 work_graph.applied (fz-kdt.34.3, one per applied job -- the completion seam), +19 pull.product.cache_hit, +11 pull.product.displaced, +14 pull.product.settled (fz-kdt.34.4 settle authority + undercount fix). Byte growth is the causality payload on those lines (reads/movements/wakes).

Fix: re-pin both fixtures' budgets to the measured stream with tight headroom, with a comment attributing the growth. The growth is proportional to work (per applied job), which is what the budget is meant to allow; creep without cause is what it must still catch.

Process note: this slipped through five tickets because the per-ticket gate was cargo test --lib; fz2_cli was not in the gate.
title: fz2_cli public-trace budgets: re-pin for the kdt.34 causality stream
